T-30.labels: own_depth_* and complement_pool_* are sizes at prices in a public book. No order is attributed to any trader. own_depth_depletion_30s is DEPLETION -- trades and cancels are indistinguishable in anonymous depth and it is never reported as traded volume. PRO_RATA is not assignable on a FIFO CLOB with anonymous depth and never appears.
